title: POST /report-subscriptions – request
description: Subscribe a supervisor assigned to a site of the caller to a report of the site. The same (user_id, site_id, frequency) twice is 409 conflict. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 201, api/report-subscription.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent.
